newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GPU seen buying 35pct of CEPA -paper.
newsitem.headline: GPU seen buying 35pct of CEPA -paper.

text.p: Hopewell Holdings Ltd is expected to sell a 35 percent stake in Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA) to GPU Inc at about HK$18.00 per share, the Hong Kong Economic Journal said on Tuesday.
It said the deal, worth more than HK$23 billion, would lead to a takeover bid for CEPA by the U.S. power company.
The newspaper quoted market sources as saying Hopewell and GPU had reached a preliminary agreement under which Hopewell had agreed to sell a controlling stake in CEPA to GPU.
It said the two sides were hammering out details before reaching an agreement.
Hopewell and CEPA officials were not immediately available for comment.
Trading in Hopewell and CEPA shares was suspended on Tuesday at the request of the companies pending announcements, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Hopewell shares closed at HK$4.425 on Monday and CEPA at HK$16.10.
